rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose rendering for a surrounding environment or setting, including a social one.

example.english: The milieu in this cha chaan teng is very comfortable, so it’s perfect for sitting down and having a leisurely chat.
example.traditional: 呢間茶餐廳嘅環境好舒服，坐低慢慢傾偈最啱。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 waan4 ging2 hou2 syu1 fuk6 co5 dai1 maan6 maan2 king1 gai2 zeoi3 ngaam1

rows.note: Use this for a social milieu understood as the particular group or social circle someone belongs to.

example.english: They fit in well in that milieu.
example.traditional: 佢喺嗰個圈子入面好吃得開。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 go2 go3 hyun1 zi2 jap6 min6 hou2 hek3 dak1 hoi1

rows.note: Use this when the social milieu means the atmosphere or feel of the setting rather than the people in it.

example.english: The milieu here is very relaxed, so everyone can speak without being so formal.
example.traditional: 呢度嘅氣氛好輕鬆，大家講嘢都唔使咁拘謹。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 ge3 hei3 fan1 hou2 hing1 sung1 daai6 gaa1 gong2 je5 dou1 m4 sai2 gam3 keoi1 gan2
